recommendation: Retain 18 and validate. The selection already covers every requested project and four strata; the binding constraint is validation and adapter support, not count. I cannot supply a CVE ID or URL for such a case with confidence and will not guess one; treat this as a search direction to be independently retrieved. Likewise, kubernetes-cve-2023-5528 is Windows-only; if its Windows-compatible regression gate cannot be met, a Linux-exercisable Kubernetes replacement should be sought rather than adding a fourth Kubernetes case, which would raise repository concentration. Do not add further Python AI-tooling cases; that cluster is already 7/18.
